apis.description:
Returns all LTI registrations in the specified account.
Includes registrations created in this account, those set to 'allow' from a
parent root account (like Site Admin) and 'on' for this account,
and those enabled 'on' at the parent root account level.

operations.summary: List LTI Registrations in an account
operations.notes:
Returns all LTI registrations in the specified account.
Includes registrations created in this account, those set to 'allow' from a
parent root account (like Site Admin) and 'on' for this account,
and those enabled 'on' at the parent root account level.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The number of registrations to return per page. Defaults to 15.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to return. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The field to sort by. Choices are: name, nickname, lti_version, installed,
installed_by, updated_by, updated, and on. Defaults to installed.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: The order to sort the given column by. Defaults to desc.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
Array of additional data to include. Always includes [account_binding].

"account_binding":: the registration's binding to the given account
"configuration":: the registration's Canvas-style tool configuration, without any overlays applied.
"overlaid_configuration":: the registration's Canvas-style tool configuration, with all overlays applied.
"overlay":: the registration's admin-defined configuration overlay

apis.description:
Create a new LTI Registration, as well as an associated Tool Configuration, Developer Key, and Registration Account
binding.
To install/create using Dynamic Registration, please use the
{file:file.registration.html Dynamic Registration API}.

operations.notes:
Create a new LTI Registration, as well as an associated Tool Configuration, Developer Key, and Registration Account
binding.
To install/create using Dynamic Registration, please use the
{file:file.registration.html Dynamic Registration API}.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the tool. If one isn't provided, it will be inferred from the configuration's title.

parameters.name: admin_nickname
parameters.description: A friendly nickname set by admins to override the tool name

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description of the tool. Cannot exceed 2048 bytes.

parameters.name: configuration
parameters.description: [Required, Lti::ToolConfiguration | Lti::LegacyConfiguration] The LTI 1.3 configuration for the tool

parameters.name: overlay
parameters.description: [Lti::Overlay] The overlay configuration for the tool. Overrides values in the base configuration.

parameters.name: unified_tool_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the tool, used for analytics. If not provided, one will be generated.

parameters.name: lock_deploying
parameters.description: When true, no new deployments of this registration can be created.

parameters.name: workflow_state
parameters.description:
"on"/"off"/"allow" set the account binding state directly (binding vocabulary).
"active"/"inactive" set the registration state directly (registration vocabulary).
All five values update both the binding and the registration to equivalent states.
"allow" is only valid for Site Admin registrations. Defaults to "off".

internal_service.description: Flag indicating if registration is internally-owned

lock_deploying.description: Flag indicating if registration is locked for deployment

inherited.description: Flag indicating if registration is owned by this account, or inherited from Site Admin

template_registration_id.description: The Canvas ID of the template registration, if this registration is inherited from a template

lti_version.description: LTI version of the registration, either 1.1 or 1.3

dynamic_registration.description: Flag indicating if registration was created using LTI Dynamic Registration. Only present if lti_version is 1.3

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the registration's last update

root_account_id.description: The Canvas id of the root account

account_binding.description: The binding for this registration and this account

configuration.description: The Canvas-style tool configuration for this registration

title.description: The display name of the tool

oidc_initiation_urls.description: 1.3 specific. Region-specific login URLs for data protection compliance

public_jwk.description: 1.3 specific. The tool's public JWK in JSON format. Discouraged in favor of a url hosting a JWK set.

scopes.description: 1.3 specific. List of LTI scopes requested by the tool

extensions.description: Array of extensions for the tool

privacy_level.description: Canvas-defined privacy level for the tool

text.description: The text of the link to the tool (if applicable).

labels.description: Canvas-specific i18n for placement text. See the Navigation Placement docs.

custom_fields.description: Placement-specific custom fields to send in the launch. Merged with tool-level custom fields.

selection_height.description: Default iframe height. Not valid for all placements. Overrides tool-level launch_height.

selection_width.description: Default iframe width. Not valid for all placements. Overrides tool-level launch_width.

launch_height.description: Default iframe height. Not valid for all placements. Overrides tool-level launch_height.

launch_width.description: Default iframe width. Not valid for all placements. Overrides tool-level launch_width.

icon_url.description: Default icon URL. Not valid for all placements. Overrides tool-level icon_url.

canvas_icon_class.description: The HTML class name of an InstUI Icon. Used instead of an icon_url in select placements.

required_permissions.description: Comma-separated list of Canvas permission short names required for a user to launch from this placement.

windowTarget.description: When set to '_blank', opens placement in a new tab.

display_type.description: The Canvas layout to use when launching the tool. See the Navigation Placement docs.

url.description: The 1.1 launch URL for this placement. Overrides tool-level url.

target_link_uri.description: The 1.3 launch URL for this placement. Overrides tool-level target_link_uri.

visibility.description: Specifies types of users that can see this placement. Only valid for some placements like course_navigation.

accept_media_types.description: Comma-separated list of media types that the tool can accept. Only valid for file_item.
